name: Fillamentum Manufacturing Czech s.r.o.
summary: Czech filament manufacturer founded in 2011 in Hulin, originally trading as Parzlich s.r.o. Vertically integrated with in-house R&D and one of the broadest exotic-polymer catalogs in Europe (PVDF, PVC, PEBA, PC/ABS, PP). ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified and, unusually for the sector, publicly traded on the Prague Stock Exchange under ticker FILL.

product_lines.name: PETG / CPE
product_lines.notes: PETG plus CPE HG100 (modified PETG) and CPE CF112 (carbon-fiber PETG)

product_lines.name: Flexfill
product_lines.notes: Flexfill TPU 98A and 92A, Flexfill TPE, Flexfill PEBA

product_lines.name: 0rCA
product_lines.notes: Nylon recycled from fishing nets, carbon-fiber reinforced

product_lines.name: NonOilen
product_lines.notes: Biodegradable engineering bioplastic marketed under the Nanoilen branding; a PLA-family blend rather than plain PLA

product_lines.name: Timberfill
product_lines.notes: Wood-fiber composite on a PLA base

product_lines.name: OBC 905
product_lines.notes: Olefin block copolymer; no established filament type id

additional_notes: No evidence found of white-labelling for other brands or of reselling another OEM, so no oem_relationships are recorded; Fillamentum does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Arkema and Westlake Chemical are base-polymer feedstock suppliers, not filament OEM partners. Distributes to 62+ countries. Price tier is a close call between premium and engineering: the consumer Extrafill lines are premium-priced while the exotic PVDF/PVC/PEBA/0rCA range sits in engineering territory; no per-kg figure was confirmed this pass. Whether Fillamentum sells build plates was not established (none found), so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: price_tier set to 'premium' though the catalog straddles premium and engineering; no confirmed per-kg pricing. OBC 905 has no mapped filament type id.
